text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, this race name...!
It's as if it was created specifically for me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen!
A GⅠ named after the holy land of theatrical revue!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to monopolize the spotlight at all costs!
Or so I'd like to say, but……

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately,
there's another protagonist taking the spotlight today.
choice_data_list: Yeah, a promising new star is...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"To think she could rise from an unknown extra
to make it all the way here."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"When we first met, I never would've dreamed this possible...
She truly is a miraculous star."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's go welcome her before the race!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I really came...
The Takarazuka Kinen... *thump-thump-thump*...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if someone like me
is really fit to be Opera O-san's rival...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
Dotou, welcome to my castle!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaaa...!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry~!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san,
sorry to barge in out of nowhere, umm...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"You are not interrupting in the slightest. Stand tall and proud.
For today—you are Cinderella!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, Cinderella?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. The youngest daughter of a poor family. From there,
she fought her way all the way to the foot of the throne."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What do you have to be ashamed of? Today, you are
more beautiful than you have ever been...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, you simply must dance with me!
Consider this an official invitation.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san... personally selected me...?
Auugh... I'm just so honored...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I'll be in your care~!
I'll give it everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha, that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm the one who will win! Before the "Overlord,"
a Cinderella is nothing more than a gnat!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyauu~, it really is kinda scary after all~~~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite being bewildered, Meisho Doto
seemed to calm down a little. Just then...

text_block_list.name: Top Contender Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You're really full of yourself, T.M. Opera O.
However...!

text_block_list.name: Top Contender Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I won't let you have your way today.
I'll mark you relentlessly...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, the race is about to start.
Let us go forth, Doto.
choice_data_list: T.M. Opera O, watch your surroundings!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Our surroundings...?
What do you mean by that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm? All the other Umamusume are looking over here.
Their glares seem awfully sharp, though...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, but it can't be helped.
Because...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because Cinderella is supposed to be
envied by her wicked stepsisters!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: You would do well to be careful, Doto.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes... Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O has not yet realized
that those gazes are directed right at her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will the king, the princess, or the wicked nobles prevail?
The courtly drama of intrigue and ambition begins.
